search_text: published ZDI-09-055 ZDI-CAN-186 Microsoft Office OWC10 ActiveX Control Loading and Unloading Heap Corruption Vulnerability 2009-08-11 CVE-2009-0562 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2009-0562 ['Microsoft'] ['Office Word'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Office. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists when loading and unloading the vulnerable control (0002E543-0000-0000-C000-000000000046) and results in transfer of control to unallocated memory. This issue can be exploited to execute arbitrary code under the context of the currently logged in user user. Microsoft has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Microsoft Office OWC10 ActiveX Control Loading and Unloading Heap Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Office. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists when loading and unloading the vulnerable control (0002E543-0000-0000-C000-000000000046) and results in transfer of control to unallocated memory. This issue can be exploited to execute arbitrary code under the context of the currently logged in user user.
